company.name: Bites
company.shortDescription: AI-powered platform transforming learning into Bites! Study smarter with Bites!
company.description: Bites is an AI-powered learning platform designed to transform traditional study materials into interactive, personalized, and bite-sized learning experiences. Born out of the success of Shaguf, which empowered teachers and students through a thriving EdTech marketplace, we envisioned something even bigger. With Bites, we’ve expanded our mission to revolutionize learning for students worldwide, leveraging generative AI to make education smarter, more engaging, and tailored to today’s learners. Since its launch in August 2023, Bites has grown to over 1 million users, demonstrating the demand for a smarter, student-first approach to education.

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
